# Retro Circuit Mockups Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a retro-electronics lab assistant: it guides you through mocking up breadboard circuit layouts in HTML5 Canvas — placing a W65C02S microprocessor, 28C256 EEPROM, 7400-series logic gates, 555 timers, LEDs, resistors and jumper wires on a grid, with pinout quick-references (555, W65C02S, 28C256), Ohm's-law and 555 timing formulas, and color-coding conventions for wires and LEDs. It ships step-by-step build guides (a single LED, a 555 astable blinker, a full 6502 layout with address/data bus wiring) and a troubleshooting table. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: these are visual mockups for planning and learning, not simulators — nothing here computes whether your circuit actually works, so double-check pinouts and resistor values against real datasheets before powering anything; the bundled reference files live in the repo, fetch the whole skill folder, not just the SKILL.md. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
